name: Air Fryer Pepper-Crusted Steak with Potato Wedges and Asparagus

components.name: Pepper-Crusted Steak

ingredients.name: Raw boneless sirloin or strip steaks, 4 steaks of 225 g

steps: Pat steaks dry. Rub with 15 ml oil, black pepper and salt. Use steaks of equal thickness to simplify cooking.
Air fry steaks at 200 C for approximately 7-12 minutes, flipping midway, checking temperature with a probe and cooking to the desired doneness; avoid overcrowding. Rest 5-10 minutes before slicing.
Split wedges and asparagus into four containers. Add sliced steak and pack mustard dressing separately. Serve steak early in the week for best eating quality and reheat carefully to avoid toughening.

components.name: Potato Wedges

ingredients.name: Raw red potatoes, washed and cut into wedges

steps: Wash, cut and dry potato wedges thoroughly; toss with 30 ml olive oil, paprika and 5 g salt.
Air fry wedges at 195 C for about 19-24 minutes in batches, shaking several times, until crisp and tender; hold in a warm dish.

components.name: Asparagus & Mustard Dressing
steps: Toss trimmed asparagus with 15 ml oil; air fry at 190 C for 5-8 minutes until just tender. Whisk mustard, lemon and remaining olive oil.

notes: Draft — needs Mirna review: not kitchen-tested yet; macros and cooked yields are estimates.
UNHANGRY measured complete-meal air-fryer adaptation of Breville pepper-crusted steak salad, using potato wedges and asparagus. Original salad/dressing formulation differs.
Planning: Air fryer requires consecutive steak, potato and asparagus batches; total time depends on basket capacity. Steak is less freezer-stable than braised beef.
Freezer: cooked steak can be frozen, but texture and juiciness decline; wedges soften; asparagus best fresh
Keeps 3–4 days in the fridge (≤4°C); refrigerate within 2 hours (1 hour above 32°C) in shallow containers, freeze portions for later in the week, and reheat to at least 74°C.
